export function exclusive(path,value,privateFile=true,maxBytes=limits.resultBytes,control){if(control!==undefined&&(!control||Object.keys(control).some(key=>!['deadlineMs','beforeCreate','observe'].includes(key))||!Number.isSafeInteger(control.deadlineMs)||control.deadlineMs<1||typeof control.beforeCreate!=='function'||typeof control.observe!=='function'))throw Error('QA_EXCLUSIVE_CONTROL');canonical(dirname(path),repo);if(control&&privateFile){const parent=lstatSync(dirname(path));if(!parent.isDirectory()||parent.uid!==process.getuid()||(parent.mode&511)!==448)throw Error('QA_PRIVATE_PARENT');}const encoded=Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(value,null,2)+'\n');if(encoded.length>maxBytes)throw Error('QA_BYTES');if(control)control.beforeCreate();if(control&&Date.now()>=control.deadlineMs)throw Error('QA_EXCLUSIVE_DEADLINE');const fd=openSync(path,'wx',privateFile?0o600:0o644);let primary,hasPrimary=false;const observe=stage=>{if(control)control.observe(stage);};try{observe('created');let offset=0;while(offset<encoded.length){const wrote=writeSync(fd,encoded,offset,encoded.length-offset);if(!Number.isSafeInteger(wrote)||wrote<1||wrote>encoded.length-offset)throw Error('QA_EXCLUSIVE_SHORT_WRITE');offset+=wrote;}observe('written');fsyncSync(fd);observe('durable');}catch(error){primary=error;hasPrimary=true;}let closed=false;for(let attempt=0;attempt<2&&!closed;attempt++){try{closeSync(fd);closed=true;}catch(error){if(!hasPrimary){primary=error;hasPrimary=true;}if(attempt===1&&error?.code==='EBADF')closed=true;}}if(closed)try{observe('closed');}catch(error){if(!hasPrimary){primary=error;hasPrimary=true;}}if(hasPrimary)throw primary;}

append(event){if(this.failed||this.closed)throw Error('QA_JOURNAL_UNUSABLE');if(!event||typeof event!=='object'||Array.isArray(event)||Object.keys(event).some(key=>['version','operation','runId','sequence','previousDigest','receiptDigest'].includes(key)))throw Error('QA_JOURNAL_EVENT');const sequence=this.sequence+1;const value=safeReceipt({version:1,operation:this.operation,runId:this.runId,sequence,previousDigest:this.previous,...event});const body=JSON.stringify(value);safeReceipt(JSON.parse(body));if(Buffer.byteLength(body)>limits.journalBytes||this.globalRowsInitial+this.windowProofRows+sequence>limits.journalRows||this.globalBytesInitial+this.windowProofBytes+this.bytes+Buffer.byteLength(body)+128>limits.evidenceBytes)throw Error('QA_JOURNAL_BUDGET');const digest=sha256(body);const line=body.slice(0,-1)+',"receiptDigest":'+JSON.stringify(digest)+'}\n';if(Buffer.byteLength(line)>1024||this.globalRowsInitial+this.windowProofRows+sequence>4800)throw Error('QA_SOURCE_JOURNAL_BOUND');const bytes=Buffer.from(line);let written=0;try{while(written<bytes.length){const count=writeSync(this.fd,bytes.subarray(written));if(!Number.isSafeInteger(count)||count<=0||count>bytes.length-written)throw Error('QA_JOURNAL_WRITE_COUNT');written+=count;}fsyncSync(this.fd);}catch(error){this.failed=true;this.partialBytes=written;throw error;}this.bytes+=bytes.length;this.previous=digest;this.sequence=sequence;return JSON.parse(body);}
